profile.name: Wasatch USB光谱仪
profile.description: 通过 FID 协议控制 Wasatch Photonics USB 2.0 光谱仪的设备接口，用于采集光谱数据，并支持扫描平均、Auto-Raman、区域扫描、激光相关测量以及温度与状态信息读取，适用于拉曼和通用光谱实验。
profile.description_en: A device interface for controlling Wasatch Photonics USB 2.0 spectrometers over the FID protocol. It is used for spectral acquisition and supports scan averaging, Auto-Raman, area scanning, laser-related measurements, and temperature/status readback for Raman and general spectroscopy workflows.

registry.name: Wasatch Photonics Wasatch
registry.description: Wasatch Photonics是由Wasatch Photonics生产的表征设备，主要功能包括初始化、扫描、设备连接、读取数据、采集。支持Signal, Slot, balance acquisition等操作。
